description: We, as MANDALİNA, are trying to develop a software for astronauts working in space to live a better quality life. Teamwork is very important to us. It makes us happy to see hardworking, respectful positive people on our team, it does not need to be very talented person, we can learn together after being hardworking
summary:
MANDALINA, uzun süreli uzay görevlerinde astronotların fiziksel ve psikolojik sağlık durumlarını takip etmek amacıyla geliştirilen C# tabanlı bir masaüstü yazılımıdır.

Uygulama; kalp atış hızı, oksijen seviyesi, vücut sıcaklığı, kan basıncı, fiziksel aktivite ve kas kütlesi gibi sağlık göstergelerini takip eder. Sleep Analysis modülüyle uyku süresi ve uyku evrelerini analiz eder. Mental Health Monitoring modülüyle ruh hâli, stres, zihinsel yorgunluk ve sosyal bağlantı gibi psikolojik göstergelerin günlük değerlendirilmesini sağlar.

Daily Brief özelliği, aktivite, beslenme ve dinlenme verilerine dayalı bilgilendirmeler sunar. SQLite ile veriler saklanır, LiveCharts2 ile grafikler oluşturulur. Bluetooth Low Energy altyapısı ise gelecekte uyumlu sağlık sensörleriyle entegrasyon için geliştirilmiştir.

MANDALINA, fiziksel ve mental sağlığı tek platformda birleştirerek astronotların uzun süreli görevlerde sağlık takibini desteklemeyi hedefler. Mevcut prototip örnek verilerle çalışmaktadır.
details:
MANDALINA – Astronaut Health Monitoring System

MANDALINA is a desktop-based astronaut health monitoring application developed using C# and Windows Forms. It aims to support the monitoring of astronauts' physical and mental health during long-duration space missions.

1. Health Monitoring

The application tracks important health indicators such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂), body temperature, blood pressure, physical activity and muscle mass. It also includes additional indicators such as fat mass and bone density. Health records are stored and can be reviewed over time.

2. Sleep Analysis

The Sleep Analysis module monitors sleep duration and different sleep stages, including REM, light sleep and deep sleep. It also displays awake time, sleep efficiency, average heart rate, oxygen saturation and breathing rate. Sleep information can be visualized through charts.

3. Mental Health Monitoring

Astronauts can complete daily self-assessments covering mood, stress level, mental fatigue, sleep quality, workload and social connection. These records help track changes in psychological well-being throughout a mission.

4. Daily Brief

Daily Brief combines available activity, nutrition-related and recovery information to provide short, data-based informational messages. It encourages astronauts to maintain balanced activity and recovery routines.

5. Data Management and Connectivity

MANDALINA uses SQLite to store health, sleep and mental health records locally. LiveCharts2 is used to visualize health trends. The application also includes Bluetooth Low Energy scanning and device connection capabilities, providing a foundation for future integration with compatible health-monitoring sensors.

6. Future Development

The current prototype uses sample data because no physical health sensors are integrated yet. Its architecture is designed to support future sensor integration and automated data collection.

MANDALINA brings physical health, sleep and mental well-being together in one platform, aiming to support astronauts in maintaining their health during long-duration space exploration.
dataRefs: NASA Human Research Program (HRP) – The Human Body in Space
